purpose: Fixed reference board and construction ledger for the first fourteen reviewed Snow Leopard icons.
copyrightBoundary: Historical Apple artwork is research-only evidence. Production PNGs are original measured reconstructions and semantic adaptations. No extracted .icns bitmap, screenshot crop, or traced Apple path is shipped as a runtime asset.

systemRules.sizePolicy: Runtime surfaces downscale the 128 px tier. For the twelve programmatic cores, 512 carries the finest texture while 32 and 16 are separately composed review hints with deleted detail, thickened structure, and moved highlights; the two accepted Image Gen cores use separately processed ledger artifacts.
systemRules.light: One controlled key light above and slightly in front, restrained ambient fill, and a short object-owned contact shadow under the lower edge. Every object in the family shares this one world.
systemRules.perspective: Mature OS X genre split: hardware is seen from a shallow top view, utilities are straight-on shelf objects, desk applications tilt slightly and rest on a surface, paper hovers front-on with a folded corner.
systemRules.materials: Painted plastic, brushed and polished steel, chrome wire, coated paper, book cloth, pencil wood, and rubber keep distinct highlight widths, edge softness, and local contrast. Material decides the gradient; no gradient is chosen for its own sake.
systemRules.alpha: Anti-aliased object edges with artwork-owned shading. No theme-wide CSS filter, hue-rotate, saturate, or drop-shadow supplies Snow Leopard depth.
systemRules.colorSpace: Reference measurements are read as sRGB. Screen captures and extracted resources are compared in the same working space so a color-management difference is never mistaken for an artwork difference.
systemRules.smallArt: At 32 delete secondary texture, keep one dominant material cue, and strengthen the silhouette. At 16 merge or move parts to protect recognition.
systemRules.toolbarBoundary: Finder and application artwork is never reused as toolbar or source-list art; those are separate small families.
systemRules.grid: Every object is placed on the shared icon grid in tooling/lib/icon-grid.mjs: one live dimension per shape class (square, portrait, landscape) with a margin that no object may cross, plus small optical allowances for shapes that read large or small at equal bounds. Objects are scaled uniformly, never stretched, so a row reads as one family while each object keeps its own proportions.

iconsets.kind: Apple CoreTypes icon resources exported to .iconset directories
iconsets.periodCaution: These exports carry @2x members up to 1024 px, so the source bundle is newer than 10.6.8. They are used only for objects whose artwork is unchanged across 10.5-10.9, and every such object is confirmed against a genuine 10.6.8 screen capture before it is drawn.
iconsets.redistribution: Local evidence only; ignored by git and excluded from every package.

captures.kind: Genuine Mac OS X 10.6.8 screen captures at 1920x1080 and window scale
captures.use: Period control for every object: Dock and desktop scale, Finder icon-view spacing, real 10.6 application family, and the objects that are absent from the exported resources.
captures.redistribution: Copyrighted screenshots; local research and comparison only.

sources.use: Icon genre rules, perspective by category, and the requirement that 32 and 16 receive their own hinted artwork rather than a mechanical reduction.
The controlling family board. One real 10.6.8 Applications folder in icon view fixes detail density, saturation, visual weight, contact shadow, and the tilt convention for desk applications.
Macintosh HD, the labeled external volume, Trash, and Dock scale.
